text:
maria: Kicking off account/project + network prep for eu-central-4 GPU pool. Need VPC layout, subnet CIDRs, peering and firewall notes so infra can mint the project tomorrow. TL;DR: 3 AZs, 48 GPUs target, private control plane, and strict egress rules.

jamal: Thanks — can you list quota requirements? GPUs + IPs + ENIs etc. Also any preferred instance families (A100, H100)?

maria: Goal initially: 48 A100s (can fallback to A100S), prefer 8x GPUs per node instance type if available. Quotas: GPU quota 48, vCPUs ~ 1536 (estimate), static external IPs minimal (NAT gateways only), ENI count high because k8s nodes + infra pods. I'll add numbers to the runbook.

priya: For VPC: propose /20 primary VPC (10.10.0.0/20) split into three /22 AZ subnets for worker nodes, one /24 for management (bastion, monitoring), one /24 for control plane peering endpoints. Need flow logs to logging project and restrict inter-AZ cross-account rules.

alex: Re: peering — do we peer with prod-net or use shared-transit? For EU4 we should go through transit gateway for centralized egress and SSO-controlled NAT. Peering only for low-latency control-plane paths.

maria: Transit gateway preferred. We'll request a transit attachment from networking team. Keep private services via PrivateLink where possible (S3/GCS endpoints).

renee: Security checklist: deny 0.0.0.0/0 ingress, only allow management CIDR and prometheus IP ranges. Audit logs enabled, KMS keys on disk encryption, HSM integration later. Also add Spoke IAM roles for on-call.

diego: Terraform plan draft: using modules/gitlab.com/redwood/infrastructure/modules/gcp-project + network. Example snippet I'm going to apply: ```hcl
module "eu4_project" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infrastructure.git//modules/gcp-project"
  project_id = "redwood-eu4-gpu-01"
  billing_account = var.billing
  labels = {env = "staging"} 
}
module "eu4_vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infrastructure.git//modules/networking"
  vpc_cidr = "10.10.0.0/20"
  az_subnets = ["10.10.4.0/22","10.10.8.0/22","10.10.12.0/22"]
  mgmt_subnet = "10.10.2.0/24"
  enable_flow_logs = true
}
```

maria: Nice. Can you include quota requests as TF resources or a one-off request to cloud-support? We need GPU quota and eni quotas before apply.

diego: I'll file the quota request after PR. Also adding a preflight check script that verifies: quotas, IAM bindings, shared VPC attachments, and routing. Sample command: `./infra/scripts/preflight --project redwood-eu4-gpu-01`

jamal: On cost: estimate monthly GPU spend at baseline ~ $28k for 48 A100s (on-demand). Add note for Dedicated reserved capacity conversation with finance/sales — we might reserve to save ~20-30%. Put that as an opt-in checkbox in the runbook.

priya: Validation steps to include in runbook: 1) subnets healthy (no overlap), 2) flow logs present and exported to logging project, 3) nodes can pull images from registry via PrivateLink, 4) control-plane endpoints reachable from prod-k8s via transit, 5) GPU drivers installed and NVRM tests pass.

maria: Assigning handoff: diego to implement TF, jamal to file quota & cost notes, renee to run security smoke and generate checklist, priya to coordinate networking/transit attachment. I'll do final sign-off and schedule a 30-min handoff tomorrow 09:30 CET. @sre-bot will post the calendar invite.

sre-bot: Created calendar invite: "EU4 GPU Project handoff" 2027-04-18 09:30 CET. Participants: maria, jamal, diego, priya, renee. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/abc123

jamal: Quick question — any constraints on reserved IP ranges for pods (CNI)? We usually reserve a /18 for pod CIDR in region to avoid future overlaps.

priya: We'll reserve 10.11.0.0/16 for pod space across clusters and use smaller /19 per cluster. Documented in runbook so future clusters in EU4 carve from that pool.

maria: Perfect. I'll start the runbook page in Confluence with the checklist and attach the TF PR when ready. Thanks all — aiming to have project green by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
